facts.statement: MarvelGame/version.json holds `version` and an integer `changelist`; the changelist equals the build number in the mapping file name.
The game runs Unreal Engine 5.3.2; CUE4Parse profile GAME_MarvelRivals.
Vanilla content is 39 IoStore containers (global + pakchunk*) in MarvelGame/Marvel/Content/Paks with about 590k packages.
Mods load from Paks/~mods, including subfolders; mod managers deploy one folder per mod.
Mods need the ASI loader (Binaries/Win64/dsound.dll) plus the UTOC signature bypass plugin.
Skin assets live in Marvel/Content/Marvel/Characters/<hero 4 digits>/<skin 7 digits>/ with Meshes/, Materials/, Materials/Lobby/, Textures/ and Post_<skin>_Physics / Post_<skin>_Lobby_Physics.
A skin id has 7 digits; its first 4 are the hero id.
A skin's materials can reference textures and parent materials of another skin id of the same hero (MI_1061303_Body_01 has parent M_1061001_Skin).
Skin VFX meshes and textures live under Marvel/Content/Marvel/VFX/{Meshes,Textures}/Characters/<hero>/<skin>/.
A mod is three files <Name>_9999999_P.{pak,utoc,ucas}; mount point ../../../.
Community mods show container_flags Compressed|Indexed or Indexed; compression Oodle.
Since Season 11 the anti-cheat reports encrypted, obfuscated and stripped mods; emit plain containers only.
retoc-rivals-cli pack <rawdir> --output <dir> names the output after the input folder and appends _9999999_P; default compression Oodle.
UAssetTool extract_iostore_legacy without --mod loads only top-level game containers, so ~mods can never leak into a vanilla base.
extract_iostore_legacy --filter is a substring match: SK_1061_1061303 also matches the _Lobby mesh and _Lobby_Physics.
extract_texture fails with an empty-path error when the output is a bare file name; pass absolute paths.
UAssetTool downloads oo2core_9_win64.dll next to its exe on the first extraction when it is missing.
list_iostore <Paks dir> --filter Characters/ lists ~134k vanilla packages in about 5 s; lines look like `../../../<path>.uasset [.ubulk|no bulk]  (export=N b bulk=N b)`.
inject_texture keeps the vanilla pixel format and writes the full mip chain (.uasset .uexp .ubulk .uptnl) by default.
T_1061303_Body_01_D (2048x2048, PF_DXT1, 12 mips) edited, injected, packed and extracted back differs from the edit by RMSE 0.27% (block compression only).
UAssetTool to_json -> from_json keeps every parameter of a MaterialInstanceConstant (26/26 on MI_1061303_Body_01); .uexp is byte-identical and an edited vector reads back.
UAssetTool JSON writes some zero floats as strings ("+0", "-0"); readers must accept both.
SK_1061_1061303 has 18 material slots; slots carry MaterialTag.* gameplay tags that must survive a mesh rebuild.

fmodel-mcp exports SK_1061_1061303 as .uemodel + material JSON + PNG in about 15 s; opened on the game Paks folder it would export an installed override mod's version, so the forge opens a vanilla hardlink view.
Blender 5.3 imports .uemodel headless through ueformat-blender without installing the add-on: vanilla SK_1061_1061303 = 95,767 vertices, 18 slots, 481 bones (sockets off).
Opening a folder of loose legacy packages in fmodel-mcp mounts but mesh conversion fails; do not use loose folders as a vanilla source.
Mappings come from SpaceDepot/rivals-depot usmap/ named 5.3.2-<build>+++depot_marvel+S<season>_release-Marvel.usmap.
The hero/skin name table is a snapshot of repak-rivals character_data.json (April 2026); newer skins appear in the index without names.
Among mods providing the same package, the later-sorted folder is assumed to win.
Textures injected at a different resolution than vanilla are assumed to load.
facts.source: unverified (assumption A5); tex replace resizes to vanilla dims by default

facts.statement: fmodel-mcp mounts every archive under the opened folder incl. ~mods; a temporary folder of hardlinks to the top-level containers (same volume) gives a vanilla-only view: 154 links in 0.03 s, 76 archives, overridden meshes resolve to pakchunkCharacter.
ueformat-blender with sockets on adds bones (488 vs the 481-bone reference skeleton of SK_1061_1061303, with extra roots); Unreal refuses multiple roots. Import with sockets and virtual bones off.
Blender names materials after the material asset; two game slots sharing one instance (Equip_05/Equip_03) merge in FBX unless each slot gets a unique material named like the game slot.
A stock UE 5.3.2 -unversioned cook of a SkeletalMesh is unreadable with the game's mappings (class schemas differ); a versioned cook converts correctly through UAssetTool create_mod_iostore.
retoc-rivals-cli 3.11.1 pack refuses versioned (tagged) cooked assets: 'Expected to find zero UE3 version'.

UAssetTool create_mod_iostore pads FSkeletalMaterial with the game's FGameplayTagContainer; tags come only from RivalsMeshMaterialManager MaterialTagAssetUserData (without it every slot's tags are empty).

The cooked mesh keeps vanilla references when placeholders exist at the vanilla paths: Skeleton and PhysicsAsset (hero 001 folder), post-process AnimBP class, one MaterialInstanceConstant per slot incl. VFX paths.
facts.source: T32 dump of the cooked mesh

facts.statement: extract_iostore_legacy --mod with a substring filter also extracts matching vanilla packages that the mod lacks; check the exact package path came from the mod.
SK_1061_1061303_Lobby has 646 bones and 19 slots (in-match: 481 / 18); both rebuild and verify.
Game build 1.1.4066382 (S11.0) has an exact rivals-depot mapping; vanilla index 318,153 packages in 40 containers.
Post_<skin>_Physics is an AnimBlueprintGeneratedClass; its CDO holds one AnimNode_* struct per node in LinkID order (Post_1061303_Physics: 73 nodes, 34 KawaiiPhysics, 52 chains).
KawaiiPhysics nodes in game data carry Chains[] with up to 11 chains per node, each with its own root bone and settings.
to_json -> from_json of Post_1061303_Physics keeps .uexp byte-identical; the CDO re-parses after appending chains.
Dropping the node-level unversioned header of AnimNode_KawaiiPhysics makes the CDO unparseable (RawExport); dropping an inner struct header (BoneSettings) works.
On 1061303 the RivetConstraint nodes that read the breast bones run before every KawaiiPhysics node; the last-evaluated KawaiiPhysics node is AnimGraphNode_KawaiiPhysics_5.
Post_1061303_Lobby_Physics has 34 anim nodes and no KawaiiPhysics node (constraints, rivets, pose drivers only).
An installed community body mod replaces Post_1061303_Lobby_Physics with an Unreal-authored AnimBlueprint (AnimInstance parent) using AnimNode_SpringBone on breast, butt and thigh bones.
facts.source: UAssetTool to_json of the installed mod

facts.statement: SK_1061_1061303: L/R_Breast_01_Jnt (parent spine_04) -> L/R_Breast_02_Jnt, about 3.4 cm apart; each weighted to about 1,100 and 930 vertices.
UAssetTool create_mod_iostore packs legacy textures (inject_texture output) and from_json physics assets together; both read back unchanged.
